protected void processEpoch(final BeaconState preState, final MutableBeaconState state)
      throws EpochProcessingException {
    // ...
    processJustificationAndFinalization(state, totalBalances);  // step 1
    processInactivityUpdates(state, validatorStatuses);          // step 2
    processRewardsAndPenalties(state, validatorStatuses);        // step 3
    processRegistryUpdates(state, validatorStatuses.getStatuses()); // step 4
    processSlashings(state, validatorStatuses);                  // step 5
    processEth1DataReset(state);                                  // step 6
    processPendingDeposits(state);                               // step 7
    // ...
    processPendingConsolidations(state);                         // step 9
    processEffectiveBalanceUpdates(state, validatorStatuses.getStatuses()); // step 10
    processSlashingsReset(state);                                // step 11
    processRandaoMixesReset(state);                              // step 12
    processHistoricalRootsUpdate(state);                         // step 13
    processHistoricalSummariesUpdate(state);                     // step 14
    processParticipationUpdates(state);                          // step 15
    processSyncCommitteeUpdates(state);                          // step 15b
    processProposerLookahead(state);                             // step 16 (LAST)
  }
